tried_and_rejected: P4 TWR measured from RPM-derived thrust while climbing: under-reads through the advance factor; rejected as measuring the wrong quantity
P4 TWR measured from peak punch acceleration: measures effective punch TWR net of sag, not the bench static the gate names; rejected
Raising kt beyond 1.98e-6 to buy accel TWR: pushes hover duty below the 0.20 harness floor; rejected
Lowering r_cell below 0.0065 to buy t80: below a healthy real 6S 1300 pack; rejected as physics softening
